title: 1,4‐Naphthoquinonediazide‐2‐carboxylic acid: a diazo compound with a long‐lived triplet excited state
abstract: Abstract                                        Laser flash photolysis (308 nm) of 1,4‐naphthoquinonediazide‐2‐carboxylic acid                     1                     in 2‐methyltetrahydrofuran (MTHF) leads to the detection of a long‐lived (5.3 μs) triplet excited state, whose triplet energy, obtained by measuring the phosphorescence spectrum of                     1                     in an Ar‐ matrix at 10 K, is ca 55 kcal mol                     −1                     (1 kcal­= 4.184 KJ). The first triplet excited state of                     1                     is quenched efficiently by 1,3‐dienes and molecular oxygen. By calculating the spin density distribution it can be shown that                     3                     1                     is not a typical naphthalene triplet, as it bears significant spin density at the diazo moiety.
